recovered_data_validation.hdf5_note: Recovered HDF5 containers may differ in bytes from previous working copies. All geometry, population counts, radii, numeric chunk order and displayed totals used by the old video are exactly equal. Raw NIO/YAML bytes and derived event bitsets/rates match. Other HDF5 content equivalence is not claimed.

kase_delay_analysis.method: Absolute MF-to-PC lag: mean of the 20 independently audited cross-correlation lags at sigma=36..55 ms, matching the paper selected range.
kase_delay_analysis.selection: Top quartile by 99th-percentile firing rate, separately for MF and PC.
kase_delay_analysis.smoothing: Triangular kernel, sigma parameter 36..55 ms; time step 0.1 ms; full lag search.
kase_delay_analysis.coordinates: Nominal paper SZ grid 0..40%, matched to stored k by condition index; right k=0.707 has nominal 29.3333% and effective 29.3%.
kase_delay_analysis.display: delta_delay_ms is baseline-subtracted lag relative to SZ 0%, as in Fig. 3a. The original absolute delay_ms is retained for provenance.
kase_delay_analysis.limitations: Sigma settings are analysis choices, not independent replicates. Instantaneous movie rates use all cells in 10 ms bins. Archived burst inputs differ across conditions; the comparison does not isolate an atrophy-only effect.

archived_input_note: Kase stimulus amplitudes and durations vary by condition; original inputs are preserved.

visual_methods.colour_quantity: Population mean rate difference, including silent cells
visual_methods.structural_colours: Fixed population identity colours; five cortical populations only.

basal_and_structure_recovered_validation.visible_population_scope: 100% Granule, Golgi, Purkinje, Basket and Stellate morphologies; no soma segments or subcortical dots.
